<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 182.073165, which matches the exact mass of C₁₃H₁₀O + H⁺ ([M+H]⁺). Subtracting a proton gives a neutral mass of 181.065889 Da, corresponding precisely to the formula C₁₃H₉O. Adding the proton back yields the molecular ion C₁₃H₁₀O⁺, confirming the molecular formula of the compound as C₁₃H₁₀O.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H10O</final_answer>
